doc.what: Per-muscle innervation for the MUSCLE INNERVATION mode: nerve, branch, root levels and innervation-zone (IZ) bands as a percentage along a named reference line between two named landmarks. Anatomy only; injection technique (counts of injection points, approach, manoeuvres) is in the private clinical layer (clinical/data/innervation_injection_q322.json).
doc.primary_source: guv2026 (Tables I-II, pp.442-443, and the per-muscle text). Facts only are extracted; no text, figures or images reproduced (CC BY-NC-ND).

fields.landmarks.<name>: {label, bone, kind (bony_point | derived | soft_tissue | muscle_derived), definition, of? (the two landmarks a derived midpoint is taken between)}. soft_tissue points need a proxy on the body, described in definition; badge it.
fields.lines.<id>: {from, to, mode, label}: 0% = from, 100% = to. mode "level" = the % fixes a level along the line; the IZ band is the muscle's cross-section at that level (a plane perpendicular to the line). mode "point" = a point on the line itself.
fields.muscles.<key>: key = muscle without side. structures.<page> = the page structure ids (both sides) the record applies to; parts[] = heads/compartments, optional structures / nerve per part.
fields.muscles.<key>.nerve[]: {id (repo nerve registry id), label, parent, registry_roots, in_registry}. nerve_structures_on_page.<page> = nerve structure ids present on that page for this muscle (may be empty: the nerve is then not modelled on the page).
fields.muscles.<key>.roots: adopted (list of levels, from the textbook registry), range_across_sources, per_source[] {src, levels, note}, conflict[]. EMG / ISNCSCI values name the dominant root only and are never merged into the adopted range.
fields.muscles.<key>.iz[]: {part, line, pct (number, [lo, hi] or null when the source gives only a qualitative site), src[], cite (page/table in the source), note?}. One entry = one IZ band.
fields.muscles.<key>.iz_other_sources[]: {src, line|null, pct|null, kind, same_line (yes | near | near_reversed | yes_reversed | muscle-relative | no), agreement (agree | near | conflict | second_zone | not_comparable), part?, note?}. Shown for comparison; never averaged with iz[] when the lines differ.
fields.sources.<id>: {citation, doi, pmid, method, n, population, landmark_match, verdict (relevant | partly | not relevant | not used), reason?, accessed}.

conventions: Percentages run from the first-named landmark of a line (the guide always says "% of the distal part of the line", i.e. measured from the proximal landmark).
Where the guide names an unspecified point ("patella", "lateral malleolus") the adopted point is given in landmarks.<name>.definition and applies to every muscle on that line.
Where Table and text disagree on a landmark, the text (which names a specific point) is adopted and the conflict is listed in the muscle's conflicts[].
IZ placement on a body is RULE-BASED: landmarks measured on that body's own bones, the band drawn at the stated level; it is badged as such with these citations.
doc.not_in_this_file: Injection point counts, needle/probe technique, dynamic manoeuvres, structures at risk -> clinical/data/innervation_injection_q322.json (private).
